firmware.what: tools/build_nr_w8a8_image.py --interactive emits a UART conversation loop: read a line, run the chat template, tokenise on the board with the encoder, feed the prompt through the decode graph one token at a time, generate, and print the decoded text
firmware.why_the_decode_graph: the compiled prefill entry is fixed at 16 tokens, so a prompt of any other length cannot use it. The decode graph is M=1 and takes its position as data, so it serves the prompt and the generation alike -- no new kernels and no recompilation per input length
firmware.why_not_nr_puts: the NR runtime's write_serial appends to a console buffer that is flushed only after launch() returns, so an interactive prompt written with nr_puts would appear all at once at the end

uart_input.problem: interactive firmware needs bytes sent TO the board; the capture path only reads
uart_input.first_attempt_failed: writing to /dev/FPGA5 from a second process raised OSError: [Errno 16] Device or resource busy -- the worker holds the device with TIOCEXCL and only restores the tty with TIOCNXCL on exit
uart_input.fix: the payloads now travel with the worker invocation: fpga_run.py forwards --uart-send to fpga_remote.py's --uart-input, and the worker writes them to the device it already owns after --uart-input-delay
uart_input.why_this_is_the_right_shape: it keeps one process owning the UART, which is the same discipline the lock enforces
uart_input.second_trap_hit: the detached worker rebuilds its command line, so the new options had to be forwarded there too -- the same trap --layout fell into earlier

board_state.detail: the 28-layer image (re-linked with the argument-order fix) has been capturing for about 21 minutes of a 9000 s window and has emitted only the boot banner, which is expected: the one-layer prefill+decode took 374 s, so 28 layers is on the order of an hour or more
board_state.stage_e_run: refused with 'another fpga_run is using this platform workdir' -- the lock working as designed; it is queued behind the full-model run rather than started
